title: pvTube
body:
## pvTube

Wraps every line or polyline of polygonal input in a tube of NumberofSides faces (ParaView default 6) and Radius, producing polydata surfaces. VaryRadius can make the radius follow a point scalar or vector array, up to RadiusFactor times Radius. The cross-section is oriented by the input's point Normals array, by normals generated along each line, or by DefaultNormal when UseDefaultNormal is true. Use it to render streamlines, particle paths or wire models in 3-D; tube is the curated version.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Duplicate consecutive points, or normals parallel to the line, make VTK skip that line; run clean first.
- Radius is in dataset units and ParaView may initialize it from the input extent (1 %); set it explicitly.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Tube`. Identity: `filters/TubeFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Tube filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Capping` | If this property is set to 1, endcaps will be drawn on the tube. Otherwise the ends of the tube will be open. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DefaultNormal` | Fixed direction [x, y, z] used as the normal at every line point to orient the tube cross-section, applied only when UseDefaultNormal is true. Otherwise VTK uses the input's point Normals array if present, or generates sliding normals along each line; the Vectors array never orients the tube. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `NumberofSides` | The value of this property indicates the number of faces around the circumference of the tube. | `{"minimum":3,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `3` |
| `Radius` | The value of this property sets the radius of the tube. If the radius is varying (VaryRadius property), then this value is the minimum radius. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `RadiusFactor` | If varying the radius (VaryRadius property), the property sets the maximum tube radius in terms of a multiple of the minimum radius. If not varying the radius, this value has no effect. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Scalars` | This property indicates the name of the scalar array on which to operate. The indicated array may be used for scaling the tubes. (See the VaryRadius property.) | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `UseDefaultNormal` | When true, every point uses DefaultNormal to orient the tube cross-section, ignoring any point Normals array. When false, VTK uses the input's point Normals if present and otherwise generates sliding normals along each polyline. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `VaryRadius` | The property determines whether/how to vary the radius of the tube. If varying by scalar, the tube radius linearly varies w.r.t point-based scalar values in the dataset. If the radius varies by vector, a mass flux preserving variation is used. If it varies by absolute scalar, the radius is equal to the scalar field (which thus must be positive!). If it varies by vector norm, the vector magnitude is used in varying the radius. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Off","By Scalar","By Vector","By Absolute Scalar","By Vector Norm"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Off"` |
| `Vectors` | Point vector array, as [association, name] e.g. ["POINTS", "U"], used only to vary the radius when VaryRadius is By Vector or By Vector Norm. Despite the upstream description, VTK's tube filter does not orient tubes by this array. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTube",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
